slides.text: Workshop template The opening Episode of a workshop: copy it once per Event for the agenda, the scope and the organisers.
Agenda Replace with the plan of the session: each block with its time slot. Time slot: first block Time slot: second block Time slot: third block Time slot: questions and wrap-up
In scope Replace with what this session covers. A topic the session covers A second topic the session covers A third topic the session covers

In scope (1/1) Page 1 of 1 Out of scope Replace with what this session leaves out, so no one waits for it. A topic the session leaves out A second topic the session leaves out A third topic the session leaves out
Organisation Replace with how the session runs. Breaks: when they are Questions: when and how to ask them Materials: where attendees find them afterwards Contact: how to reach the host
